comparison.note: The figures have been reselected to include important bright stars. Old and new corner counts compare complete proposals, not the same fixed figures.

sample.timingScope: Rich timing starts with uncached generation and includes audit measurements. Balanced timing is cumulative from that seed start, and its root boundary is cached. These are offline tests, not browser or mobile timing guarantees.

automated_tests.scope: Local fairness oracle, major-star ranking, RA seam editing, 12 complete draws, real boundary edits, invalid edits, manual replay, source metadata cache isolation, locked rerolls and seven historical versions.

checks: browser draw matches offline data, major stars and per-region local minima are visible
coordinate editing and actual pointer dragging update the shared grid; undo restores the original
redo restores the edit and an illegal movement keeps the last valid draft intact
save creates a separate manual round, retaining locks, notes and favourite while removing automatic optimum badges
manual data survives reload and export/import with exact integer boundaries
editing an existing manual round back to the automatic original can be saved
cancel restores the initial record and data without saving draft changes
390px editing controls stay within the page and all fifteen figures fit the common display scale
old draw-7 remains intact and visibly reports its omitted bright stars
the old boundary-cleanup action still means draw-3 to draw-4

guarantees.brightness: All three brightest stars and all stars with apparent magnitude <=3 in each actual final region are in both the complete figure and its connected core. This is a cultural selection policy, not an IAU rule.
guarantees.corners: Independent local lower bounds retain all fixed ownership. Descending excess corner counts are minimized lexicographically, followed by total corners. Exact scope is the fixed 1-degree RA/Dec grid, chosen reference figures, masks and protected ownership.
guarantees.compactness: Deterministic inward edge trimming preserves each regional corner count; no global minimum-area or minimum-cell guarantee.
guarantees.manual: Moves change the single ownership grid and rebuild every region. Stars, arcs, topology, widths, margin and no-new-bright-omissions are checked. An edited round never inherits an automatic optimum certificate.
guarantees.historicalManual: A manually edited old round can retain existing bright omissions. The UI reports them, and edits cannot introduce new missing important stars.

limitations: Only six independent full-sky boundary seeds were sampled; some other seeds may exhaust layout attempts or solver time and are rejected without replacing the current round.
Numerical MILP bounds with integer and geometry postchecks are used; no exact-arithmetic proof file is produced.
Manual editing preserves existing members and lines. A boundary change requiring different star membership is rejected; generate another figure to change members.
scope: Independent constellation workbench only; source stellar values and formal V1/V2 maps remain unchanged.
